meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 执行完整发布流程：确认版本类型（patch/minor/major）、触发GitHub Actions工作流、等待并验证npm包和GitHub Release、生成发布说明、尝试发Discord公告。只发布，不做代码审查或修复。
howto.when: 当你要求发布（说“publish”“release”“deploy”等），并明确指定版本类型（patch/minor/major）时触发。若未指定版本类型，会停下来要求你提供。

say.note: Claude会确认并发起发布流程。
会触发工作流并验证产物。
注意它会发布并验证，不修代码。

howto.what_en: Acts as release manager: confirms the bump type (patch/minor/major), triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, waits for completion, verifies npm packages and the GitHub release, writes release notes, and attempts a Discord announcement. Publish-only: no code review or fixes during publish.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to publish/release/deploy (e.g., 'publish', 'release', 'npm publish') with an explicit bump type (patch/minor/major). If no bump type is given, it stops and asks for one.

say_en.note: Claude confirms and starts the release flow.

say_en.text: Help me publish a minor version to npm.
say_en.note: It triggers the workflow and verifies artifacts.

say_en.text: Cut a major release for these changes.
say_en.note: It publishes and verifies; no code fixes.
